system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Global and project rules are **combined** (global first, then project)
system_prompt_style.note: AGENTS.md rules and skills list are injected into the system prompt at runtime ('Code Puppy automatically injects available skills into the system prompt', docs/AGENT_SKILLS.md). The evidence bundle contains README and docs only, not the prompt-assembly code, so the source line is not cited.

env_context_strategy.note: Navigation tools are list_files, read_file and grep. No up-front context injection is documented.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: after auto-compact, which inserts a compaction-summary system message alongside the agent's own system instructions
context_compaction.note: Default is auto-compact, which writes a summary. Manual /truncate <N> drops the oldest messages. Source file code_puppy/agents/_compaction.py exists but its contents are not in the bundle.

observation_format.note: The observation conversion code is not in the bundle. A browser_screenshot.py file exists, which suggests screenshots, but its contents are unseen.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Models without tool calling support show a big warning since they can't use Code Puppy's file/shell tools
tool_call_format.note: The system is built on pydantic-ai, which uses provider tool calls. No parser code is in the bundle.

tool_count.note: The README lists 11 tools; skills, browser and subagent tools also exist. The exact default tool list is not visible in the bundle, so no count is recorded.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: **`apply_patch`**: Codex/OpenCode-style multi-file patches (`patchText`) supporting add, update, delete, and move
edit_primitive.note: Also documented: edit/replace_in_file (search_replace) and create_file (whole file). apply_patch is given to Codex/Responses models.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Use the `/mcp` command to manage MCP (list, start, stop, status, etc.)
tool_schema_source.note: The auto_generated value is inferred from the pydantic-ai framework (code_puppy/_pydantic_tool_helpers.py exists), not from a cited line.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Using MCP Servers for External Tools

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Code Puppy is an AI-powered code generation agent, designed to understand programming tasks, generate high-quality code, and explain its reasoning
loop_primitives.note: The run loop is not in the bundle. Files agent_planning.py and agent_model_judge.py exist, but how they are used is unknown.

planning_granularity.note: An agent_planning.py file exists but its contents are not in the bundle.

multi_agent_topology.note: Subagent tools (tools/subagent_invocation.py, agent_tools.py) exist. Whether they are enabled by default is unknown.

delegation_mechanism.note: subagent_invocation.py exists, which suggests subagent_spawn, but the code is not in the bundle.

human_in_loop.note: file_permission_state.py and ask_user_question exist, but no policy code is in the bundle.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Truncates the message history to keep only the N most recent messages while protecting the first (system) message.
short_term_state.note: Inferred from README describing message history as working state; state class not in evidence.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Agent Skills are reusable, modular capabilities that extend Code Puppy's functionality.
long_term_memory.note: file_notes refers to AGENTS.md files that the user writes, which the agent reads. This is borderline as memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: durable-execution plugin that survives crashes and lets you resume long agent runs
state_persistence.note: DBOS is an optional extra. Session storage and autosave also exist.

self_verification.note: agent_model_judge.py exists, but its contents and wiring are not in the bundle.

rollback.note: undo_manager.py exists, but its contents are not in the bundle.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: This feature automatically cycles through configured models with each request
cost_controls.note: Round robin is used for rate limits, not cost, so it is only borderline as model_routing. claude_cache_client.py exists, which suggests caching.

timeouts.note: Model request timeouts of 180s also exist.

execution_isolation.note: The docs recommend that the user run it in a container; no sandbox is shipped.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Any files Code Puppy has access to

permission_model.note: file_permission_state.py and hook_engine exist, but the code is not in the bundle.

tracing.note: observability.py exists, but its contents are not in the bundle.

guardrails.note: The hook engine and .claude/hooks/block-sed.py suggest pre-tool hooks. The code is not in the bundle.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Playwright-backed browser tools are not installed on Android.
